figs.name: condensate-pot-working-principle-flowchart
figs.alt: condensate pot working principle flowchart from steam condensing to equal liquid columns
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a condensate pot works: steam condenses, the pot fills, the column reaches the transmitter and equal legs give the true process DP.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 545" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Working principle of a condensate pot flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="545" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#164e63" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a Condensate Pot Works</text>
<rect x="25" y="65" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110.0" y="99.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Steam enters</text>
<text x="110.0" y="122.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">impulse line</text>
<line x1="195" y1="105" x2="218" y2="105" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="65" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="305.0" y="99.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Heat loss</text>
<text x="305.0" y="122.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">condenses it</text>
<line x1="390" y1="105" x2="413" y2="105" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="415" y="65" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="500.0" y="99.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Condensate</text>
<text x="500.0" y="122.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fills the pot</text>
<line x1="585" y1="105" x2="608" y2="105" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="610" y="65" width="170" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="99.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Column reaches</text>
<text x="695.0" y="122.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">transmitter</text>
<polyline points="695,145 695,195 400,195 400,228" fill="none" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,233.0 570.0,288 400,343.0 230.0,288" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="283.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Both legs filled</text>
<text x="400" y="304.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">equally?</text>
<line x1="400" y1="343" x2="400" y2="388" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="372" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="230" y="390" width="340" height="72" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="420.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transmitter senses</text>
<text x="400.0" y="443.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">only the true process DP</text>
<line x1="570" y1="288" x2="603" y2="288" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="586" y="278" font-size="17" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="605" y="230" width="180" height="116" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="259.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fix it</text>
<text x="695.0" y="282.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fill both pots to</text>
<text x="695.0" y="305.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the same level,</text>
<text x="695.0" y="328.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check heights</text>
<rect x="20" y="230" width="200" height="116" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="120.0" y="259.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Without a pot</text>
<text x="120.0" y="282.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">live steam above</text>
<text x="120.0" y="305.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">200 °C reaches</text>
<text x="120.0" y="328.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the diaphragm</text>
<text x="400" y="505" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Equal condensate columns cancel out, so only the process DP is measured</text>
</svg>

figs.name: condensate-pot-temperature-and-materials-infographic
figs.alt: steam above 200 °C vs transmitter limit about 85 °C and condensate pot materials
